tutorial_outline.direct_instruction_goal: Explain that time reversal is a left-right mirror about $t=0$ and that reflection changes time coordinates from $t_0$ to $-t_0$ without changing amplitudes.

paragraph_plan: State the reflection rule: $x(-t)$ is the graph of $x(t)$ mirrored across $t=0$.
Use one isolated feature at a positive time as the base case.
Move that feature to the matching negative time and keep its amplitude unchanged.
Generalize the same sign change to every other time coordinate on the graph.
Close with the fixed-point case: anything already on $t=0$ stays where it is.
